description: The audit hash chain has at most one root row with no previous hash.
query:
WITH roots AS (
  SELECT id, created_at, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY created_at, id) AS root_position
  FROM trust_ops.audit_logs
  WHERE previous_hash IS NULL
)
SELECT id, created_at, root_position
FROM roots
WHERE root_position > 1
ORDER BY root_position;

description: Every audit log row has a non-empty SHA-256 immutable hash.
query:
SELECT id, immutable_hash, previous_hash
FROM trust_ops.audit_logs
WHERE immutable_hash = '' OR length(immutable_hash) <> 64
ORDER BY created_at, id;

description: Every non-root audit row points to an existing immutable hash.
query:
SELECT child.id, child.previous_hash
FROM trust_ops.audit_logs AS child
WHERE child.previous_hash IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM trust_ops.audit_logs AS parent
    WHERE parent.immutable_hash = child.previous_hash
  )
ORDER BY child.id;

description: No immutable hash is referenced as the previous hash by multiple audit rows.
query:
SELECT previous_hash, count(*)::int AS referencing_rows, array_agg(id ORDER BY id) AS row_ids
FROM trust_ops.audit_logs
WHERE previous_hash IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY previous_hash
HAVING count(*) > 1
ORDER BY previous_hash;

description: Every existing billing statement number has a sequence row whose next number is above the highest issued number for that year.
query:
WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT id, number,
    CASE WHEN number ~ '^BS-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]+$' THEN split_part(number, '-', 2)::int END AS year,
    CASE WHEN number ~ '^BS-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]+$' THEN split_part(number, '-', 3)::int END AS sequence_number
  FROM finance_ops.billing_statements
), invalid_numbers AS (
  SELECT id, number, NULL::int AS year, NULL::int AS highest_sequence, NULL::int AS next_number,
    'billing statement number does not match BS-YYYY-NNNN' AS violation
  FROM parsed
  WHERE year IS NULL OR sequence_number IS NULL
), highest AS (
  SELECT year, max(sequence_number) AS highest_sequence
  FROM parsed
  WHERE year IS NOT NULL AND sequence_number IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT id, number, year, highest_sequence, next_number, violation
FROM invalid_numbers
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL::text AS id, NULL::text AS number, highest.year, highest.highest_sequence, sequences.next_number,
  'sequence row is missing or does not exceed the highest existing statement number' AS violation
FROM highest
LEFT JOIN finance_ops.billing_statement_sequences AS sequences ON sequences.year = highest.year
WHERE sequences.year IS NULL OR sequences.next_number <= highest.highest_sequence
ORDER BY year NULLS LAST, id NULLS LAST;

description: The Prisma migration ledger contains no unresolved migration rows.
query:
SELECT migration_name, started_at, finished_at, rolled_back_at
FROM public._prisma_migrations
WHERE finished_at IS NULL AND rolled_back_at IS NULL
ORDER BY started_at, migration_name;

description: Every PARE review payload with a digest reference is an object and its SHA-256 matches the stored JSONB payload.
query:
SELECT approval.id AS approval_id, audit.id AS audit_id, audit.sanitized_payload->>'reviewPayloadDigest' AS review_payload_digest
FROM trust_ops.ai_approval_records AS approval
JOIN trust_ops.ai_audit_logs AS audit ON audit.id = approval.ai_audit_log_id
WHERE approval.feature_name = 'PARE'
  AND audit.feature_name = 'PARE'
  AND (audit.sanitized_payload->>'pareProvenanceVersion' = '1' OR audit.sanitized_payload ? 'reviewPayloadDigest')
  AND (jsonb_typeof(approval.review_payload) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
    OR COALESCE(audit.sanitized_payload->>'reviewPayloadDigest', '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    OR encode(sha256(convert_to(approval.review_payload::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex') <> audit.sanitized_payload->>'reviewPayloadDigest')
ORDER BY approval.id;
